Review Title: For urostomy, this barrier ring is the best one we have tried so far.
Review: I read all the unhappy reviews and will not challenge other people's issues. My son has a urostomy stoma. These rings stretch just fine, they adhere very well, but the best feature is that they come off in one piece when changing the pouch. I have tried two other brands that disintegrate after use and I have to spend a long time carefully removing the remnants of the ring when changing the pouch. And that wet material sticks to everything; not a fun experience. These Carbou barrier rings do not disintegrate into mush. I really don't want to use any other brand for that reason alone. His medical supply company doesn't carry the Carbou brand so we will have to always purchase these ourselves. That is worth not having to struggle. And his skin doesn't get irritated either. I recommend giving these a try.

The fecal matter would get in between my skin and the wafer. I was going through sometimes two or three changes in one day.  It was annoying and very expensive. I started researching online. That's when I found out I needed a barrier and came across the Adapt Barrier Rings. I remembered those little circles I had tossed in the back of that drawer.
